mentions.name: RISC-V Microcontroller Operating System
mentions.description: This project is an operating system written to run on RISC-V microcontrollers, built as a hands-on way to learn RISC-V assembler using newly purchased microcontrollers and electronics components.
mentions.source_excerpt: I just bought a few microcontrollers and electronics bits to mess with, I want to write an operating system for it to learn risc-v assembler
